diagnostics.message: `google_alloydb_user.users` only depends on `google_alloydb_cluster.primary` (via its `cluster` attribute). Creating database users is a real-world operation that requires the cluster's primary instance to exist first — the official provider documentation for google_alloydb_user includes `depends_on = [google_alloydb_instance...]` in every example. Without this ordering, Terraform may create the users concurrently with (or before) `google_alloydb_instance.primary`, and user creation can fail or race against instance provisioning. Add an explicit `depends_on = [google_alloydb_instance.primary]`; there is no attribute on the user resource that can reference the instance, so a data-dependency fix is not applicable.
